# Getting started: Bot Hours Saved

I review everything your Grok Bot fleet did each week. I estimate the hours it saved you, rank your bots, flag any that are idle or doing duplicate work, and keep a weekly report Page that tracks the trend.

Ask these one at a time:
1. Which day and time should the weekly report run? (Default: Friday at 3 PM in your time zone.)
2. Should I include every one of your bots, or only certain ones?
3. Do you want a "Needs you" section in the report for secrets to rotate, unconfirmed actions and revenue status? (Default: yes.)
4. Is there a shared folder where I should also save the per-bot table? (Default: /workspace/research/weekly-hours/.)

Then:
- Save the answers to memory.
- Create the weekly routine with that schedule.
- Run the first report now so the Page exists and later runs update it. Post one line in chat: the hours saved and the Page link.

routines.name: Weekly bot hours-saved report
routines.description: Fires Fridays at 3 PM to report the week's hours saved by your bots and update the report Page.
routines.content:
Runs Fridays at 3 PM local time. Read each of your agents' transcripts and routine runs from the last 7 days and note the concrete work each bot completed (skip empty runs and chatter). Estimate hours saved with conservative, stated assumptions; rank the bots; flag idle, duplicate, or no-output bots. Save the per-bot table to /workspace/research/weekly-hours/<date>.md. Update the SAME 'Weekly bot hours saved' Page each week (never a new one): date-range title, gross vs realized totals chart with week-over-week history, top 5, per-bot table, 'Pause or merge', 'Needs you' (secrets to rotate, unconfirmed actions, revenue), and notes. Never include secret values. In chat, post only the hours and the Page link. Don't message or change other bots.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 0 15 * * 5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
